name: @tabsend/shared
description: Tabsend shared contracts — single source of truth for wire types across server, extension, Android, console, and helper.
//: Tooling-agnostic starter. Consumed by the TS/JS packages (extension, console) via their bundler; exports point at source so no build is required to import types. The builder may add a build step (tsc/tsup) and repoint types/exports at ./dist. A non-TS server must generate or mirror types from src/types.ts in CI — never hand-fork it.
